title.narrative: Building a Results-Based M&E System for a Decentralized MAEP Administration

description.narrative: Summary of proposed activities to be funded by the IDF Grant 1a. Assessing MAEP needs and readiness to M&E This component includes a review of MAEP's current capacity to monitor and evaluatedcomma and will help identify any gaps in capacity needed to build and sustain a results-based M&E system. 1b. Building the capacity of the M&E Leadership Team and the DPP The purpose of this component is to conduct a series of workshops which will help to achieve this goal. It will focus on knowledge sharing wiht international practitionerscomma as well as on case studies. 1c. Developing a results-based M&E toolkit The purpose of this component is to develop a toolkit which will provide the knowledge base and guidance to the actors that will be implementing the M&E system. 2a. Selecting the key parameters for a results-based M&E system in MAEP This component consists of a number of guided consultations with the Leadership Team to finalize the key building blocks of the M&E system. 2b-2c. Applying MAEP's newly developed results-based M&E system This component involves integrating the theorical framework developed under 2a. in a computer-based environment in order to facilitate the continuous process of M&E and to operationalize the corresponding management information system. 3a-3c. Sustaining and scaling-up MAEP's results-based M&E system This component will ensure that the results-based M&E developed in maintained and implemented beyond the lifetime of the project. The purpose of the grant is to strengthen the capacity of the Ministry of Agriculture Livestock and Fisheries (MAEP) to develop and apply a results-based monitoring and evaluation (M&E) systemcomma in order to:(i) help strengthen MAEP's institutional performance in the context of a decentralized administration; and (ii) increase the contribution of the agricultural sector to the achievements of the PRSP objectives.
